newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Rise in NZ bankruptcies, drop in liquidations seen.
newsitem.headline: Rise in NZ bankruptcies, drop in liquidations seen.

text.p: WELLINGTON, July 24 (Reuter) Registrar of Companies Neville Harris said on Thursday his department was forecasting an increase in bankruptcies but a fall in liquidations in the coming year.
He told Parliament's Commerce select committee there was a worldwide increase in consumer indebtedness and this was causing a rise in bankruptcies.
"We expect the effect to flow into New Zealand," Harris said, adding that the figures had "spiked in the passed six months".
